name: t
comment: base64 + UTF-8 string decoder (the "transport container" layer)

name: s
comment: string dispatcher: stringTable[(key ^ xorKey) & mask] -> per-char decode

name: re
comment: per-char XOR/rotate decode step (the string VM)

name: ie
comment: string VM driver: runs re() over an encoded string

name: si
comment: iframe detector: reads window.location.ancestorOrigins ([] in a top tab)

name: sa
comment: location-property reader: calls e(window.location), returns it if a string
